question.text: The correct acidity order of phenol (I), 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde (II) and 3-hydroxybenzaldehyde (III) is

solution.text: $\begin{array}{llll}\text { pKa } & 9.95 & 7.61 & 8.98\end{array}$ Acidic Strength $II \gt III \gt I$ -CHO is electron withdrawing group which increases acidic strength of phenolic compound. Also withdrawing effect of -CHO is more through para position as compound to meta position.
